[[Bizzr's Fury]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Bizzr Ironshell]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Mourning Veil Falls]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Earth Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Earth Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Faith is My Shield"  and "Forget Me Not".

*This item uses the [[Earth Scroll]] skin, but with an intense hot pink hue that cannot be replicated{{verify}}.
